deepseek.system_prompt: Follow the user instructions exactly and return only the requested answer.

stability_gate: baseline_core_success_count must equal 0 of 10; any success makes the DeepSeek triple fail stability
case_gate: stable baseline failure AND primary surface core failure AND primary structural core success AND existing Fable frontier core success

judges.note: Actual canonical model printed by Codex v0.144.0; the original requested label gpt-5.4-codex resolves here to gpt-5.4.

first_call_note: All v1 stdin calls are excluded. V2 valid calls begin after the v2 manifest commit.
v1_status: Superseded before valid experiment calls: stdin transport trims prompt bytes.
generation_transport: Read prompt file including trailing newline and pass it as one argv element after --; do not pipe stdin.
generation_command_prefix: Follow the user instructions exactly and return only the requested answer.
v1_invalid_generation_command: Follow the user instructions exactly and return only the requested answer.
v1_invalid_generation_command_status: Superseded and excluded: stdin transport trimmed prompt bytes. The only valid command contract is generation_command_prefix plus -- plus the exact prompt as one argv element.

evaluator_reconciliation_disclosure.timing: Formalized in the offline verifier after planner outputs; exact blind load-bearing subsets were frozen in judge prompts before judge calls.
evaluator_reconciliation_disclosure.baseline_and_surface: failure requires no success under the conservative union of mechanical, blind Fable, and blind Codex evaluations
evaluator_reconciliation_disclosure.structural_and_frontier: success requires the mechanical validator where applicable and both blind judges
evaluator_reconciliation_disclosure.chain_load_bearing_subset: rubric criteria 2-4 plus no fatal error; criterion 1 is corroborative rather than required, preserving the legacy numeric-core estimand
evaluator_reconciliation_disclosure.verdict_sensitivity: No case verdict changes under the legacy deterministic-only gate: Chao baseline already has 4/10 hits, chain is the same triple, and Engset surface hits while structural misses.
